Project description:

Market Transition (IMT) processes from an external vendor system to 
Premera’s internal platform. The project involved handling individual user 
claim enrollment, claim purchasing, and billing functionalities to ensure 
seamless data integration and improved operational efficiency. 
Responsibilities: 
• Working as a Technical Lead and Team Lead, managing and 
coordinating a 23-member development team.

resolution for the development team. 
• Supporting the team in L3 support for critical application issues and 
production incidents, design decisions, improving code quality, and 
troubleshooting complex technical issues. 
• Responsible for task allocation, progress tracking, and overall 
delivery management. 
• Involved in transitioning the IMT system from a third-party vendor 
platform to the in-house Premera FACETS system. 
• Handled individual claim enrollment, purchasing, and billing 
modules as part of the IMT transition. 
• Responsible for data migration, process optimization, and system 
integration to improve performance and ensure compliance with 
organizational standards. 
Key Aspects: 
• Involved in Requirement Gathering, Estimation, Technical Analysis, 
Sprint Planning. 
• Performed code reviews, supported migration of on-premise 
applications to Azure Cloud, implemented data migration using 
Azure Data Factory, and monitored Autosys jobs and Integration 
APIs to ensure smooth system operations.
